purpose: isolated image-to-3D input study; inferred design proposal
prompt:
Create ONE isolated full-body character view to serve as a reference for image-to-3D reconstruction. The first image is the accepted identity and has highest priority for the face, blue eyes, blue wavy hair, maid outfit and compact body proportions. The second image is an inferred turnaround for structure only. The third image overrides ONLY whale-tail coloration: cool deep indigo dorsal surface, muted soft blue underside, never vivid turquoise.
Show this SAME female anime whale maid character as a carefully sculpted high quality 3D anime model, a single three-quarter front view at approximately 20 degrees yaw so both eyes, both arms and both legs are clearly seen. Preserve the broad rounded cheeks, large expressive BLUE irises with dark upper iris and luminous lower blue, tiny nose, short rounded chin, navy-to-muted-blue grouped S-wave hair, five coherent bangs, white lace headband, blue side bows, whale-fin ears with white scalloped undersides, navy maid dress, white apron with a small blue whale emblem, small collar bow and brooch, short white socks and navy Mary Jane shoes. Hair has thick curved volume and curls, not ropes, polygon shards or needle tips. Use a compact but not baby two-head body: main head cap excluding ahoge about 43 percent of full standing height. Upper limbs are softly extended slightly away from the torso in a gentle relaxed A-pose with both small bare hands visible and fingers grouped naturally. Feet are apart and soles share the same plane. Keep the hair behind the arms so shoulder/elbow/wrist connections and torso silhouette remain legible.
A substantial curved whale tail emerges from the lower back behind the skirt, sweeps toward the viewer's right and ends in a clearly sculpted, rounded two-lobed horizontal whale fluke with a central notch. Tail has real thickness and rounded upper/lower planes. It is not a fishtail skirt, mermaid legs, single leaf, shark fin or two disconnected blades. There are exactly two separate legs.
Render cel shaded sculpted anime with broad clean continuous surfaces, fine dark outlines, controlled smooth toon lighting and restrained glossy eyes; match the reference visual identity closely. Provide coherent 3D volume on the head, cheeks, hair, sleeves, skirt and tail, with no intersecting solids or visible joints. Neutral friendly closed-mouth expression. Complete uncropped ahoge, hands, hair tips, tail and feet. ONE character only, centered with modest margins. Transparent background, no scene, no ground plane, no props, no text, no collage. This is a design reconstruction proposal, not evidence of original author geometry.
